line.en: free council fireworks at heaton park, wythenshawe park and platt fields. reduced-noise display at 17:00, lantern parade and main show at 20:00. no tickets needed; go early for a spot.
line.de: kostenlose stadtfeuerwerke im heaton park, wythenshawe park und platt fields. leiser display um 17:00, laternenumzug und hauptshow um 20:00. keine tickets nötig.
line.tr: heaton park, wythenshawe park ve platt fields'ta ücretsiz belediye havai fişekleri. 17:00'de daha az gürültülü gösteri, 20:00'de fener yürüyüşü ve ana gösteri. bilet gerekmiyor.

sparks.why: Manchester City Council fireworks at Heaton Park, Wythenshawe Park and Platt Fields on Sat 7 Nov, 17:00 and 20:00, free, per the Visit Manchester 2026 listing and JustPark as shown in search results; the council announcement found only confirms the return, so re-check manchester.gov.uk.
